proposal.summary: armv8_dec_aes_gcm_full() in Arm AArch64cryptolib before 86065c6 fails to verify the AES-GCM authentication tag due to an improperly initialized variable, allowing a man-in-the-middle attack.
proposal.cwe_quote: This occurs because of an improperly initialized variable.
